copyright_policy.rule: Do not reproduce copyrighted textbook or form text unless licensed, official, or firm-private.

source_cards.rule_text: A PI workflow output must abstain from displaying a legal proposition as verified unless a source card supplies a citation, pinpoint, quote or permitted extract, verification status, and review status.
source_cards.source_title: Demo Litigation Firm Source-Backed Drafting SOP
source_cards.quoted_excerpt: No source card means no legal proposition; no pinpoint means not verified; no human review means research layer only.

source_cards.rule_text: For research triage only, a PI negligence analysis should identify whether the facts support foreseeability, proximity, and whether it is fair, just and reasonable to impose a duty.
source_cards.source_title: HK Tort PI ontology seed note
source_cards.quoted_excerpt: Screen duty by asking whether physical injury was foreseeable, whether the parties were proximate, and whether policy or special-defendant concerns require lawyer review.

source_cards.rule_text: For research triage only, breach should be mapped to the risk of injury, seriousness of potential injury, practicability of precautions, and any evidential inference such as res ipsa loquitur.
source_cards.source_title: HK Tort PI ontology seed note
source_cards.quoted_excerpt: Record the hazard, who controlled it, what warning or precaution was absent, and what documents or witnesses can prove the standard of care.

source_cards.rule_text: For research triage only, causation should be separated into factual causation, legal causation or remoteness, and any intervening act.
source_cards.source_title: HK Tort PI ontology seed note
source_cards.quoted_excerpt: Separate the factual question of whether the accident caused the injury from the legal question of whether the loss is too remote or interrupted by later events.

source_cards.rule_text: For research triage only, PI matters must be screened for contributory negligence, consent, illegality, and limitation before drafting or advising.
source_cards.source_title: HK Tort PI ontology seed note
source_cards.quoted_excerpt: Do not draft a liability view without a limitation date, claimant conduct screen, and any defence facts raised by the proposed defendant or insurer.

source_cards.rule_text: For research triage only, PI damages should be structured into general damages, special damages, earnings loss, future loss, care, medical expenses, aids or equipment, interest, deductions, and missing proof.
source_cards.source_title: HK PI damages ontology seed note
source_cards.quoted_excerpt: Treat quantum as a structured proof exercise: each claimed head needs facts, documents, calculation method, and review status before it can be used in a schedule.

source_cards.topic: Hong Kong court forms / latest official source check
source_cards.rule_text: Court forms should be treated as general reference material unless the latest official version and governing legislation are checked before use.
source_cards.quoted_excerpt: The documents set out below are for general reference only and should not be treated as a complete and authoritative version of the law.

source_cards.rule_text: If a node lacks source support, the UI must display source missing or verification required and must not produce a verified legal answer or final drafting recommendation.
source_cards.source_title: Demo Litigation Firm Source-Backed Drafting SOP
source_cards.quoted_excerpt: When the source trail is missing or unverified, stop at research triage and route the item to lawyer review.
